data.narrative:
Reflection AI is a Series A–stage AI & Software company founded by Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with the nearest-stage peers including Scale AI, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs, all in Series B.

The Stage-Progression method was not applicable. The reported last post-money valuation of $25.0B triggers a sanity check: implied forward value of $50.0B exceeds total capital raised ($2.0B) by more than 20x, suggesting a data integrity issue in the base figure. The Peer-Median method, comparing to three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, yields a central estimate of $5.6B (range: $3.2B to $29.0B). Scale AI trades at the high end of the peer set at $29.0B, while Black Forest Labs anchors the low end at $3.2B; Physical Intelligence sits at the median at $5.6B.

Triangulation across the single applicable method produces a valuation range of $4.8B to $6.4B, with a median of $5.6B. This estimate carries material uncertainty given reliance on one method and the wide dispersion among peers (9.0x between min and max). The Series B stage of most comps introduces some upside optionality relative to Reflection's current stage, though the $2.0B in prior fundraising provides some constraint on the lower bound.
